# Package Scope

ID: EXECUTAR-AGENTIC-EDITORIAL-SYSTEM-PACKAGE

This package consolidates the editorial agentic architecture, campaign workflow, dependency checklists, Assets/CTA/Store schema, Design Handoff, route/copy contracts, component registry, governance sources, Process Doc, references and source Skill.
